newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin orders Kirovo chemicals plant stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin orders Kirovo chemicals plant stake sale.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin ordered the government to sell the state's 38 percent stake in the Kirovo-Chepetsky Chemicals Combine at an open auction, the presidential news service said.
The decree, dated July 5, does not say whether foreigners will be allowed to participate in the sale and does not set a date for the auction.
The news service said the plant, located in Kirov in Central Russia, produces latex, mineral fertilisers and liquidified and gaseous oxygen and nitrogen.
The factory was previously on a list of objects with national security importance which could not be sold but Russia has been paring down the list as it seeks new revenues.
The primary shareholders of the firm, with over 15,000 employees, are the federal government with 38 percent, employees with 40 percent and TOO IATs Analyse with 22 percent, the news service said.
